Ruling (wave-18 toggle): an on/off toggle whose off state the same action reverses is WRITE + multiplex, extending the wave-17 pause ruling. Agent read: Toggles an alert via POST :setActive?active=${active}. The required checkbox makes disable an ordinary option, so the rubric says tag the worst case. That worst case is DESTRUCTIVE under the precedence-1 'disables' rule and wave-9, but WRITE under the wave-17 pause ruling, because this same action re-enables the alert. The rulings conflict here.
